_purpose: Dishes, stored as amounts only. Every macro is derived by scripts/adapt_recipe.py from data/foods.json — the same rule the Asian Base Block follows. Nobody types a calorie figure for a dish.
_workflow: 1. Find a recipe anywhere. Keep the link.
2. Add it here as ingredients + grams + steps. Amounts as found, not as wished.
3. Run scripts/adapt_recipe.py. It scales the protein and fibre sources to hit the target and reports what it changed.
4. Cook it. If the real thing differs, fix the grams here, not the macros.

_schema.title: display name
_schema.slot: mirror | breakfast | snack — mirror dishes are adapted to profiles.mirrorMeals
_schema.person: philipp | eunice | null — null means both, which is the point of a mirror meal
_schema.servings: how many portions the amounts below produce
_schema.blocks: Asian Base blocks per serving; 0 for dishes that carry their own carb
_schema.source: where it came from — a link, or who it belongs to
_schema.ingredients: [{ food: id from foods.json, g: grams, note?: 'as bought' }]
_schema.steps: Ninja OL750 method, numbered, with mode/level/time where it matters
_schema.computed: written by the script — do not edit by hand
_schema.adapted: written by the script — what it had to change to hit the target

recipes.title: Die Vorratsdose — Skyr, Schoko & Nuss
recipes.source: der geteilte Nachmittags-Baustein — eine Schale, drei Tage, beide
steps: Trockenes zuerst: Whey, Haferkleie, Leinsamen, Kakao, Zimt und Salz gründlich mischen
Nussmus mit ZWEI Dritteln der Mandelmilch glattrühren — erst dann unter den Skyr, sonst bleiben Klumpen
Trockenmischung und Vanilleextrakt unterrühren, 20-30 Min. quellen lassen, dann NOCHMAL durchrühren
In EINE Schale (~1.5 kg), kalt stellen. 9 Portionen: Philipp 2 am Tag, Eunice 1. Eine Portion sind ca. 155 g
Das letzte Drittel Mandelmilch bleibt im Kühlschrank. Haferkleie und Leinsamen quellen drei Tage weiter — ab Tag 2 pro Portion einen Schluck unterrühren, dann ist die Konsistenz wie an Tag 1
Banane erst beim Essen unterheben, ca. 30 g. Wer mehr Ballaststoffe will, nimmt stattdessen 80 g gefrorene Beeren
